import unittest

class Contract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        import routes as m
        data = {'/api': 'base', '/api/v1': 'v1', '/api/v1/users': 'users'}
        self.assertEqual(m.choose('/api/v1/users', data, 'none'), 'users')
        self.assertEqual(m.choose('/api/v1/items', data, 'none'), 'v1')
        self.assertEqual(m.choose('/api/other', data, 'none'), 'base')
        self.assertEqual(m.choose('/apix', data, 'none'), 'none')
        self.assertEqual(m.choose('/x', {}, 'none'), 'none')
    def test_forwarding(self):
        from gateway import forward
        rules = {'/api': 'shared', '/api/v1': 'shared'}
        before = dict(rules)
        self.assertEqual(forward('/api/v1/items/1?x=%2F&x=2', rules, 'none'),
                         {'target': 'shared', 'path': '/items/1', 'query': 'x=%2F&x=2'})
        self.assertEqual(forward('/api', rules, 'none'),
                         {'target': 'shared', 'path': '/', 'query': ''})
        self.assertEqual(forward('/apix?q=1', rules, 'none'),
                         {'target': 'none', 'path': '/apix', 'query': 'q=1'})
        self.assertEqual(forward('/api%2Fhidden', rules, 'none')['target'], 'none')
        self.assertEqual(rules, before)

from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from routes import mount, choose
def forward(url, routes, fallback):
    parsed = urlsplit(url)
    prefix = mount(parsed.path, routes)
    target = choose(parsed.path, routes, fallback)
    path = parsed.path if prefix is None else parsed.path[len(prefix.rstrip('/')):]
    return {'target': target, 'path': path or '/', 'query': parsed.query}
